long_biography.plain_text:
Hermansson grew up around the shipping partnership created by Knut Hermansson and Sture Svanström, whose families began acquiring vessels together in the early 1960s. He and the other founders' sons learned the business before the next generation assumed operational responsibility.

Today he is deputy managing director and a board member of Tarbit Shipping in Sweden, as well as a director of the group's Dutch operation. He also chairs Orion Shipping and is registered as one of Tarbit's beneficial owners through that company. This ownership distinguishes him from a salaried executive, but it does not make the group's fleet, revenues or subsidiary assets his personal property. The transfer mechanism for his interest—inheritance, gift, purchase or retained earnings—is not disclosed. His identifiable business wealth remains centered on maritime transport, particularly specialist tanker shipping, without implying ownership of every vessel or the group's balance sheet.
